title: Astryx
description: Join our Server using the Astryx Mod-Pack!
body:
# **Welcome to Astryx**
Astryx is a Multiplayer Modpack experience built for everyone — no strict rules, no forced factions, no political drama. Just you, your friends, and a version of Minecraft that goes a little deeper than vanilla.
Whether you want to automate your entire base with complex machinery, explore dungeons you've never seen before, build something that actually looks good, or just vibe and mine — Astryx has something for you. The modpack expands on what Minecraft already does well without completely reinventing it. It feels familiar, but with more to discover around every corner.
There's no pressure to play a certain way. Team up with others, go full solo hermit, or somewhere in between — the server is open and relaxed by design. The goal is simple: give everyone a richer world to mess around in.
So grab your pickaxe, pick a direction, and see where it takes you.

## Discord
Feel free to join our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/R7UDJaZEBc) to share your builds or chat with other People!

_PS: This also the place to get whitelisted: 
Just put your ingame-name into the designated channel in the minecraft Category!_
